source_title: EG INVESTOR ALERT: Everest Group, Ltd. Investors with Substantial Losses May Seek to Lead the Everest Group Class Action Lawsuit
source_excerpt:
SAN DIEGO , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP announces that purchasers or acquirers of Everest Group, Ltd. (NYSE: EG ) common stock between February 8, 2024 and October 27, 2025, inclusive (the "Class Period"), have until December 28, 2026 to seek appointment as lead plaintiff of the Everest Group class action lawsuit. Captioned City of Detroit General Retirement System v. Everest Group, Ltd. , No. 26-cv-09448 (S.D.N.Y.), the Everest Group class action lawsuit charges Everest Group and certain of Everest Group's top current and former executives with violations of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
If you suffered substantial losses and wish to serve as lead plaintiff of the Everest Group class action lawsuit, please provide your information here:
https://www.rgrdlaw.com/cases-everest-group-ltd-class-action-lawsuit-eg.html
You can also contact attorneys Ken Dolitsky or Michael Albert of Robbins Geller by calling 800/851-7783 or via e-mail at [email protected] .
CASE ALLEGATIONS : Everest Group, together with subsidiaries, provides reinsurance and insurance products.
The Everest Group class action lawsuit alleges that defendants throughout the Class Period made false and/or misleading statements and/or failed to disclose that: (i) Everest Group remained materially exposed to and concentrated in casualty risks subject to escalating claim costs, including business defendants claimed Everest Group had reduced or exited; (ii) Everest Group had inadequately priced portions of that business; (iii) Everest Group's reserves were insufficient, causing it to understate its liabilities and expenses and materially overstate its earnings; and (iv) addressing these problems would require substantial reserve charges, protection against further adverse development, and reductions in Everest Group's casualty business, thereby sacrificing recurring premium revenue.
THE LEAD PLAINTIFF PROCESS : The Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995 permits any investor who purchased or acquired Everest Group common stock during the Class Period to seek appointment as lead plaintiff in the Everest Group class action lawsuit. A lead plaintiff is generally the movant with the greatest financial interest in the relief sought by the putative class who is also typical and adequate of the putative class. A lead plaintiff acts on behalf of all other class members in directing the Everest Group class action lawsuit. The lead plaintiff can select a law firm of its choice to litigate the Everest Group class action lawsuit. An investor's ability to share in any potential future recovery is not dependent upon serving as lead plaintiff of the Everest Group class action lawsuit.
